description: Property identifier. If the input file had an `aoi_id` column it is preserved; otherwise generated from row index (0-indexed).
Area of the roof age instance, in square feet.
The unique ID for the class of this feature.
A description of the class of this feature.
Feature ID of the roof age instance.
URL to view this row in Nearmap MapBrowser. Per-class files (roof, building, etc.) frame the URL on each feature's centroid; the rollup frames it on the parcel.
Feature ID of this feature's parent in the API hierarchy. For the new Building class, this points to the Building Lifecycle ancestor.
IoU (Intersection over Union) score with the parent feature (≥0.005 to assign).
First capture after roof installation.
Reference date for age calculation. When --until is set, this is the requested cutoff (clamped to the dataset's nearest snapshot date).
Last capture before roof installation.
Human-readable evidence type description.
Estimated roof installation date.
URL to view roof age timeline in MapBrowser.
Latest imagery capture date analyzed.
Earliest imagery capture date analyzed.
Version of the roof age prediction model used.
Number of images analyzed.
Reliability of age estimate (higher = more reliable).
Calculated roof age in years (as_of_date − installation_date).
How age was determined (numeric code; see evidence_type_legend in README.md).
Whether this feature is the parcel's primary feature for its class — selected by the largest-intersection strategy (see README → Primary Feature Selection).
Whether assessor records (year built) were used in determining roof age.
Whether relevant building permits were used in determining roof age.
Type of estimate. One of `roof` (roof section) or `parcel` (property-level). Parcel-level estimates are only provided when no imagery is available.
